events.content:
## IGV Evidence Panel — chr20:200000, dataset IMP01

Before generating images, I confirmed locus quality (`bam_stats_at_locus`, chr20:199,500–200,500): mean depth 36.7×, mean MAPQ 60.0, low-MAPQ fraction 0.0 — this is a well-mapped, non-repetitive region, so downstream signals don't need the repetitive-region caveat. `applicable_layers` confirmed all four evidence layers are structurally usable for this BAM (paired reads present, SA tags present).

**Note on the position itself:** it was supplied directly by you, not pulled from a registered candidate set, so nothing here confirms chr20:200000 is an actual caller-derived breakpoint — just the coordinate I was asked to inspect.

All four requested panels were generated successfully. I only have opaque image references (no pixel data, no file path), so I cannot and will not describe what the images show — only what was generated and what a reviewer should look for:

| Layer | Region | Coloring | Image ref | Dimensions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Discordant pairs | chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500bp) | UNEXPECTED_PAIR | IMG_7e7c | 1140×1112 |
| Soft-clipped reads | chr20:199,850–200,150 (±150bp) | NONE | IMG_1afa | 1074×1074 |
| Split reads | chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500bp) | UNEXPECTED_PAIR | IMG_3eca | 1140×903 |
| Read depth | chr20:197,000–203,000 (±3000bp) | NONE | IMG_0433 | 1140×1112 |

One numeric detail was returned alongside the soft-clip panel (not from the image itself, from the tool's own tally): in the ±150bp window it sorted reads by LEFT_CLIP and found **14 left-clipped vs 6 right-clipped reads**. That's a raw clip-count observation, not a pileup-position or evidence-strength verdict — I have not run `soft_clipped_reads` or `breakpoint_evidence_summary` yet to determine if these cluster tightly enough to count as a real breakpoint signal.

**What a reviewer should check in each panel:**
- **Discordant pairs**: whether inter-chromosomal or anomalously-oriented pairs cluster near chr20:200000, and whether their mates cluster on one partner chromosome (suggesting a real translocation) vs. scatter across many chromosomes (background noise).
- **Soft-clipped reads**: whether left- vs right-clipped reads pile up at a single consistent position (given 14 vs 6 split observed, check if either group localizes tightly rather than scattering).
- **Split reads**: presence and clustering of supplementary (SA-tagged) alignments spanning the site, and where their partner segments map.
- **Read depth**: whether coverage is flat through the 6kb window (expected for a balanced event) or shows a drop (deletion) / rise (duplication) centered near 200,000.

I have not yet run the quantitative evidence tools (`discordant_pairs`, `soft_clipped_reads`, `split_reads`, `read_depth_profile`, or `breakpoint_evidence_summary`) — only the panel-generation call and the upfront quality check. If you want an actual interpreted verdict (evidence_strength, depth ratios, discordant-pair fractions, etc.) rather than just images, I can run those next.
